title: Type 1 diabetes predicted effector genes (Onengut-Gumuscu S and Rich SS, 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays predicted effector genes for type 1 diabetes (T1D) and the supporting evidence for the predictions. The list was generated by Suna Onengut-Gumuscu and Stephen S. Rich (unpublished work, 2022). It predicts T1D effector genes at the loci associated with T1D at genome-wide significance in this study:

Fine-mapping, trans-ancestral and genomic analyses identify causal variants, cells, genes and drug targets for type 1 diabetes
Robertson CC, Inshaw JRJ, et al.
Nat Genet. 2021 Jul;53(7):962-971. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00880-5.
PMID: 34127860

Click the "View" button in each row to see the evidence supporting each prediction. Click on the "Research Method" tab for more details.
